item.title: 8 of 9 missing skiers found dead; 6 rescued following California avalanche near Lake Tahoe
item.description: It is the deadliest avalanche in the U.S. since 1981, when 11 climbers were killed on Mount Rainier, Washington.

item.title: Pilot killed after small plane crashes neighborhood in Poplar Grove, Illinois identified
item.description: The pilot of a small plane who died after it crashed into a residential neighborhood in northern Illinois has been identified as an 83-year-old man, officials said.

item.title: Body found in Fox River in South Elgin identified as man missing since November, officials say
item.description: A body found in a west suburban river this week has been identified as a man who was missing for months, officials said.

item.title: Michelle Yeoh honored with star on Hollywood Walk of Fame: 'I'm so psyched'
item.description: Oscar-winning actress Michelle Yeoh has been honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

item.title: Injuries reported in shooting on I-90 expressway in Chicago, southbound lanes reopen, ISP says
item.description: Injuries were reported in a shooting Wednesday evening on the inbound I-90 expressway on Chicago's North Side, state police said.

item.title: Jewish students allege they were harassed at cafe near DePaul campus in Lincoln Park
item.description: Chicago police and nearby DePaul University are both investigating the alleged incident, which witnesses say turned physical. The cafe involved has denied the allegations.

item.title: Rev. Jesse Jackson's children speak on death of civil rights icon; services set for next week
item.description: Five of the Rev. Jesse Jackson's six children appeared together Wednesday morning to talk about the love they have for their father in Chicago.

item.title: Clergy allowed inside Broadview ICE facility for Ash Wednesday after federal judge's order
item.description: On Ash Wednesday, for the first time in months, clergy members were allowed inside the Broadview ICE facility, thanks to a lawsuit arguing the Department of Homeland Security violated religious freedom protections.

item.title: CPD officers on controversial tactical team stripped of police powers, reassigned as lawsuits mount
item.description: After a year-long investigation into the most complained about Near North Side CPD tactical team, the ABC7 I-Team has learned four members have been relieved of police powers, and others have been reassigned.

item.title: Gust of wind blows baby girl in stroller into Lake Michigan on North Side, man helps save child
item.description: A gust of wind blew a baby girl in a stroller into Lake Michigan on Chicago's North Side, the man who dove in to save the child told ABC7 from his hospital bed.
